page.overview:
Who is Ryoko Kakyoin?

Ryoko is a slender and short Japanese girl. She has long hair that is tied into a ponytail. Her hair is tied into braids that are swept to the side. Like her cousin, she wears a single cherry earring and has a long, curly bang.

Ryoko is seen as a conceited person but is mostly polite. She is also seen standing up for others, like protecting an old woman from an annoyed driver. And helping hol horse and Josuke

At some point during 1988 near the beginning of Part 3, she had went with her older cousin Noriaki to go on a trip to Egypt with their family. There they both encounter Dio. Noriaki is given a fleshbud by Dio, though Ryoko had escaped the scene.
